crossRefs.note: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.
Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.
They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
Yahweh says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City…
Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

translations.web: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
translations.bsb: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.
translations.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
translations.asv: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
